example.name: bug_report_to_pr_workflow
example.scenario: User reports a bug: "App crashes when opening settings without internet."

step.description: Analyze and copyedit prompt into structured GitHub issue format
Extract repo owner and repo name from git config --get remote.origin.url
Search existing issues for duplicates; none found
Present drafted issue to user and get approval
Create issue on GitHub via MCP tool (create_issue), receiving issue #123 (left open)
Create branch issue-123-offline-settings-fix, hand off fix task to Orchestrator/Code mode with strict sub-mode instructions (modify files and run local tests only; no commit or push)
Upon return from fix mode, inspect git diff and test output. Hit Hard Stop Gate #3: present review to user and wait for explicit approval.
Upon approval, commit changes on branch issue-123-offline-settings-fix with raw reference Fix settings crash when offline (Fixes #123), push branch to origin, and open PR #124 into main.

Execute Phase 6 post-merge cleanup: evaluate CAN_MERGE (true), offer PR merge to user, execute merge_pull_request upon approval, return local workspace to default branch via git checkout main && git pull, and delete remote feature branch issue-123-offline-settings-fix from origin.

example.completion: Successfully created GitHub issue #123, implemented and tested fix on branch issue-123-offline-settings-fix (without unauthorized sub-mode commits), passed Hard Stop Gate #3, committed, pushed, opened PR #124, merged PR, restored local workspace to main via git checkout main && git pull, and deleted remote feature branch. Task successfully completed.
